# Psalm 40 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Of-David. A-psalm.

**2** I-waited patiently for-YHWH, and-He-inclined to-me and-heard my-cry.

**3** And-He-brought-me-up from-a-pit of-destruction, from-the-miry clay, and-He-set my-feet upon a-rock, establishing my-steps.

**4** And-He-put in-my-mouth a-new song, a-praise to-our-God. Many shall-see and-fear, and-shall-trust in-YHWH.

**5** Blessed [is] the-man who makes YHWH his-trust, and-does-not turn to-the-proud and-those-going-astray to-falsehood.

**6** Many [are the things] You-have-done, YHWH my-God — Your-wonders and-Your-thoughts toward-us; none can-compare to-You. I-would-declare and-speak [of them] — they-are-more than-can-be-numbered.

**7** Sacrifice and-offering You-did-not desire — ears You-dug for-me — burnt-offering and-sin-offering You-did-not ask.

**8** Then I-said, 'Behold, I-come; in-the-scroll of-the-book it-is-written concerning-me.

**9** To-do Your-will, my-God, I-desire, and-Your-Torah [is] within my-inward-parts.'

**10** I-have-proclaimed good-news-of righteousness in-the-great assembly; behold, my-lips I-do-not restrain — YHWH, You know.

**11** Your-righteousness I-have-not hidden within my-heart; Your-faithfulness and-Your-salvation I-have-declared. I-have-not concealed Your-steadfast-love and-Your-truth from-the-great assembly.

**12** You, YHWH, will-not withhold Your-compassions from-me; Your-steadfast-love and-Your-truth continually preserve-me.

**13** For innumerable evils have-surrounded-me; my-iniquities have-overtaken-me, and-I-am-not able to-see. They-are-more than-the-hairs of-my-head, and-my-heart fails-me.

**14** Be-pleased, YHWH, to-deliver-me; YHWH, hasten to-my-help.

**15** Let-them-be-put-to-shame and-humiliated together, those-seeking my-soul to-destroy-it; let-them-be-driven-back and-disgraced, those-delighting in-my-harm.

**16** Let-them-be-appalled because-of their-shame, those-saying to-me, 'Aha! Aha!'

**17** Let-all those-seeking-You rejoice and-be-glad in-You; let-those-loving Your-salvation say continually, 'Great [is] YHWH!'

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **40:7-9**: Hebrews 10:5-7 quotes these verses (from LXX) as Christ's words. 'A body You prepared for me' replaces 'ears You dug for me' — a Christological reinterpretation of the sacrifice principle.

— EMET
